kāyamoneyya.p: [Kāya+moneyya] (na) CL=7 One who has a good knowledge of the body door. The sainthood practice that makes first and foremost the body. (A) Removes three factors of wholesome deeds by the physical body. (B) Three factors of wholesome deeds by the physical body. (C) The wisdom that appears in the senses as a physical body. (D) Know and distinguish a physical body. (E) Magga that knows and distinguishes the physical body. (F) Removes interest and passion of the body. The cession of bodily function that is the 4th Jhānasamāpata which is the so-called physical sage-hood.
